text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE fired: gpu.memory.pressure on prod-gpu-pool-12 (severity=P1). PagerDuty incident: PD-9876. Node: gpu-node-17.us-west2. Trigger: sustained 95th mem usage > 98% and 12 OOM events in 2m.

maria-oncall: acked and joining. Starting quick triage — standing by for logs.

pagerduty-bot: PD-9876 assigned to maria-oncall.

dave-eng: seeing CUDA alloc failures in the tail, logs show "CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY" and rapid kv-cache evictions.

maria-oncall: paste logs from node:
```
[2026-03-17T02:31:12Z] nvml: GPU 0 OOM alloc 124MB
[2026-03-17T02:31:13Z] runtime: kvcache_eviction count=128
[2026-03-17T02:31:14Z] infer: request_id=abc123 latency=12ms error=CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
```

tony-sre: copying metrics — memory spike correlates with a batch job (model-optimize-job-7) ramp at 02:30Z. Throughput shot up 4x on pool-12.

maria-oncall: quick mitigation plan: 1) drain new requests from gpu-node-17 2) scale fallback to cpu-instances for low-priority customers 3) cancel/kill model-optimize-job-7 if it's the cause.

ops-bot: Initiating graceful drain on gpu-node-17 (evicting running inferences with 30s grace).

carol-support: Notifying affected customers (slack channel #cust-ab-queued). Carol will send an initial automated message stating degraded inference performance and that we're investigating.

dave-eng: echoing — I can push a temporary routing rule to divert non-critical routes to dedicated-d-2 (lower latency but CPU-backed) — should reduce pressure.

maria-oncall: go for it, dave. Also enable kv-cache aggressive eviction thresholds to free memory: set kvcache.eviction_target=0.7

tony-sre: FYI I'm rotating in at 02:40Z for the next shift. If this stays active, I'll take PagerDuty. @maria-oncall, please handoff after you've applied mitigations.

maria-oncall: applied routing change and drain started. Killed model-optimize-job-7 via orchestrator (job id: moj-7-442). Memory usage on node dropped from 99% -> 62% over 45s.

ops-bot: drain complete, node marked maintenance. No further OOMs on node-17 in the last 90s.

maria-oncall: marking PD incident as 'acknowledged' and adding note: "mitigated by draining node and killing noisy job; routing fallback applied; monitoring for regressions." Will handoff to @tony-sre in 5m.

pagerduty-bot: PD-9876 status updated: acknowledged by maria-oncall. Escalation timer paused.

carol-support: Sent customer note to AB-42 and BC-13. Both acknowledged. AB-42 reports 12% failed requests earlier, now recovering.

tony-sre: taking over now. I'll keep PD open until we're stable for 15m and then transition to post-incident evaluation. Thanks for the rapid actions, team. :thumbsup:

maria-oncall: +1 handoff complete. Leaving runbook notes: "root cause suspected: batch job unbounded mem growth; remediation: kill job, enable kv-cache eviction, route low-priority traffic to CPU pool, consider cgroup limits on batch jobs."

dave-eng: creating a follow-up ticket EDU-2308 to add guardrails to model-optimize jobs (max-gpu-memory, concurrency limit). Assigning to eng-runtime.

ops-bot: PD-9876 annotated: mitigation steps recorded. Closing automated paging loop.

carol-support: Customer follow-up scheduled. We'll send a post-mortem update if incident remains a P1.

maria-oncall: closing channel — monitoring for 20m. If we see new OOMs, page as usual.

(reacts) tony-sre: :eyes:

incident-bot: note: auto-alert thresholds will be reviewed; consider adding batch-job ramp detection to reduce noisy pages.
